payload.text: Landings (vc, 19 Oct 06:11Z): apply a patch only into a primary that holds no one else's uncommitted hunks. git status first, and if anything there is not mine, stop and tell vc. Every START says light or heavy (gtools-vc's terms from 06:06Z): any build, whole suite, Chrome, dry run or cut is heavy and runs alone; a light run (no build, no GUI or daemon, no port, only its own temp dirs) may share the window with one heavy run, and a failure that looks like timing beside a heavy run is rerun alone before it counts.
